newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks close with new moderate rise.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks close with new moderate rise.

text.p: Argentine stocks continued their mild-mannered advance Wednesday but closed shy of the 600 mark on shrinking volume, dealers said.
The blue-chip MerVal index rose 0.7 percent to 597.05, stretching November gains to 4.5 percent.

"The market is still doing very well but the session is just too long these days to keep up the momentum, especially after a heavy session's trade like yesterday," said Humberto Lopez of Wainbuch traders.
Bolsa hours were extended one hour October 28 to match the Wall Street close during U.S. daylight savings time.
The broad market index tacked on 0.5 percent, with winners beating decliners 31 to 23 and 20 issues closing flat.

Construction stock Polledo led main-tier gains with a surge of 8.5 percent on rumors it would soon be acquired by a local holding company, dealers said. Power utility Central Puerto rallied 4.6 percent and steelmaker Acindar advanced 3.2 percent.
MerVal losers were led by petrochemical concern Ipako, agricultural holding company Cresud and steelmaker Siderca, off 2.7 percent, 1.8 percent and 0.9 percent, respectively.
